description: Image Description: The image depicts a nighttime urban street scene featuring a pedestrian crosswalk. The crosswalk is marked with white stripes and has traffic signals on both sides displaying green pedestrian lights, indicating that it is safe to cross. There are two signs placed on the crosswalk that read "REGARDEZ à gauche puis à droite," which translates to "LOOK left then right" in English. The street is lined with buildings that appear to be residential or commercial, with some lights on indicating activity inside
